items.name: Backhaul
notes: Used for relay-to-exit reverse tunnel patterns in references/tunnels.md.
Tunnel token is a secret and must be masked.

items.name: nftables DNAT relay
notes: Use for relay outbound forwarding when reverse tunnel data path fails.
Requires ip_forward, NAT table, masquerade, conntrack sizing, and rollback.

items.name: Azumi67 6TO4-GRE-IPIP-SIT
notes: Upstream README describes the project as educational.
Can change routes, firewall behavior, timers, and tunnel interfaces.
Review before production use and keep rollback steps.

items.name: IPTABLE-Tunnel-multi-port
notes: Community project found in azavaxhuman public repos.

items.name: ping-tunnel
notes: Community project found in ppouria public repos. Review before use.

items.name: SSH reverse tunnel
notes: Suitable for management access, not high-volume user traffic.
Use autossh/systemd and key-only auth when appropriate.

items.name: FOU/IPIP
notes: Requires Linux kernel support and UDP path validation.
Payload is not encrypted unless the carried protocol provides encryption.

items.name: Azumi67 Backhaul script
notes: Bootstrap downloads an additional Python manager from a GitHub release.
Review both stages and generated systemd services; pin a release for production.

items.name: Paqet Tunnel Manager
notes: Reviewed manager changes systemd, sysctl, security limits, and iptables.
Capture pre-change state and test rollback away from production.

items.name: Musixal Rathole Tunnel
notes: Both entrypoints were reachable during review.
Scripts may add a fixed raw.githubusercontent.com address to /etc/hosts; do not preserve that behavior.

items.name: DaggerConnect
notes: Installer downloads release binaries and writes services and optional network tuning.
User-supplied 4.2.x operational claims are unverified against reviewed public release metadata.
